SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7566
17-10-36
Section 2, Special Branch Shanghai,
REPORT
Date October 16, 1936.

Subject Allegations made by one W. LOCH regarding Probationary Sergeant
W. J. ROGOVENKO during visit to Deputy Commissioner (Divisions).
Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by [Signature]

Following the conducting of very discreet enquiries, I
have to report that there appears to be no truth at all in
the assertions of W. X LOCH alias HANSEN regarding Probationary
Sergeant W. J. Rogovenko's becoming a Soviet citizen and his
contemplated journey to Russia.

Waldemar or Vladimir Loch, who is a German of Russian
extraction, was born at Tomsk on May 23, 1910. He was educated
at St. Francis Xavier's College in Shanghai and was a fellow
student of Rogovenko. In 1931-2 Loch was a member of the
Light Battery, S.V.C., during which time Rogovenko was also
a volunteer in the same company.

In the latter part of 1931 whilst Loch was cleaning his
service revolver, he inadvertently fired a bullet that had
not been ejected from the chamber breech, with the result that the
shot passed through his skull, necessitating an operation,
during which a part of his brain was removed. Since that
time, there have been occasions on which Loch is said to be
by no means in full possession of his faculties, and often
mentally unbalanced. Indeed, it is the concensus of opinion
of people who know Loch, that he is not at all times responsible
for his actions.

Inspite of this, however, Loch is looked upon as a
thorough rascal and waster. He was fined $50 on June 20,
1933 at the Shanghai Special District Court, having been charged
with assault (Ref.: Hongkew 1417/33), whilst at the same court
on March 5, 1934 he was sentenced to ten days' detention in
connection with a breach of Traffic Regulations (Ref.: Sinza).

He has been well cared for by his father, J. Loch, of
41 Rue du Consulat, a man who is favourably regarded by the

D.C.(D.V)
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH SHANGHAI 16 OCT 1936）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 7566
1936年10月17日
上海特别科第二股，
报告
日期：1936年10月16日。

事由：关于 W. LOCH 在向副总监（各区）拜访期间对见习巡长 W. J. ROGOVENKO 提出的指控。
由 D.S. Pitts 呈报 转交人 [签名]

经过极为谨慎的调查，本人谨此报告，W. X LOCH（化名 HANSEN）关于见习巡长 W. J. Rogovenko 已成为苏联公民并计划前往俄罗斯的断言似乎毫无事实依据。

Waldemar 或 Vladimir Loch 是一名俄裔德国人，1910年5月23日出生于托木斯克。他在上海的圣方济各沙勿略学院（St. Francis Xavier's College）接受教育，是 Rogovenko 的同学。1931至1932年间，Loch 是上海义勇队（S.V.C.）轻炮连的成员，在此期间 Rogovenko 也是同一连队的志愿队员。

1931年下半年，Loch 在擦拭其配发左轮手枪时，不慎击发了尚未从枪膛中退出的子弹，结果子弹穿过他的头骨，导致必须施行手术，术中切除了一部分脑组织。自那以后，据称 Loch 有时神志并不完全清醒，且经常精神失衡。事实上，认识 Loch 的人普遍认为，他并非在所有时候都能对自己的行为负责。

尽管如此，Loch 仍被视为一个十足的无赖和废人。1933年6月20日，他在上海特区地方法院被控袭击罪（参考案卷：虹口 1417/33），被罚款50元；同年3月5日，他在同一法院因违反交通法规（参考案卷：新闸）被判处拘留十天。

他一直由其父亲 J. Loch 悉心照料，其父住在领事馆路41号，在当地德侨社群中享有良好声誉，但他却以向父亲至少五十名客户借款（金额从10美元到75美元不等）来回报这份善意，其父从事医院及医疗用品进口业务。在几乎所有情况下，儿子都声称“我父亲会摆平一切”。在其他情况下，儿子曾试图替父亲追讨欠款，并在某些情况下成功了，但他总是将收回的款项据为己有。W. Loch 曾有过几份不错的工作，但他不愿或无法胜任，如今已变得极其懒惰，干脆拒绝工作。鉴于这种情况，老 Loch 先生大约在两个月前让儿子离开家，自谋生路。不久之后，父亲致信法国巡捕房，询问是否能提供协助以促使儿子改邪归正。（法国巡捕房 - 10607）。

（左侧批注及印章）：
D.C.(D.V)
（印：上海特别科 1936年10月16日）

COPY

J. LOCH

HOSPIAL SUPPLIES, PHYSICAL AND
LABORATORY APPARATUS.

Shanghai, 1.8.36.

Chief of French Police,
French Concession,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

I take the liberty of soliciting your assistance
in the following case:

Vladimir Loch, aged 26, my son by my first mar-
riage, has caused a great deal of trouble during recent years.
He is lazy, a liar and never remains more than a few weeks
with any employer, who dismiss him on account of his bad
habits. I have ejected him from my own home a hundred
times, but he always returns after doing something idiotic,
such as borrowing under false pretences sums of money from
my clients, etc.

He has already cost me a fortune and I do not
know what to do. I wanted to place an announcement in
the Press, but the newspapers will not accept such an
announcement without permission of the Court or the Police.

I am informed that Vladimir Loch is residing at
56 Route Vallon at present. I want to get rid of him and
I ask you to let me know what can be done in this matter
should you be able to afford me assistance.

Yours, etc.

J. LOCH.

J. LOCH

医院用品、物理及
实验仪器。

上海，1936年8月1日。

法国巡捕房总监，
法租界，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

冒昧就以下案件恳请您的协助：

Vladimir Loch，26岁，是我第一次婚姻所生的儿子，近年来给我带来了诸多麻烦。他懒惰、撒谎，在任何雇主那里都干不过几周，雇主因其恶习而将其解雇。我曾上百次将他赶出家门，但他总是在做了一些蠢事之后又回来，例如以虚假借口向我的客户借款等。

他已经让我破费巨资，我不知该如何是好。我想在报纸上刊登一则声明，但如果没有法院或警方的许可，报社不会接受此类声明。

据悉，Vladimir Loch 目前居住在瓦隆路56号。我想摆脱他，如果您能提供协助，请告知我在此事上可以采取什么措施。

此致，

J. LOCH。

------

French Police report dated August 4, 1936 (10607)
--------------------------------------------------

During the afternoon of August 4, 1936 Mr. J.
LOCH, German, came to the office and confirmed the
contents of the attached letter addressed to the
Chief of Police. He does not wish to see his
son and only wishes the Police to make a record of
certain sums of money borrowed by the latter from
certain of the father's clients.

The son Vladimir is at present residing at 56
Route Vallon. He attended our office at our request
and was informed of the complaint that his father had
made. He maintained that he had been "kicked out"
of home by his father without reason. He stated that
he was unemployed and borrowed the money from friends
but not from his father's clients. He was made to
understand that should any official complaints be
forthcoming he would be placed under arrest and be
sent before the competent court to undergo trial.

The father was informed of our efforts and he
was satisfied.

Signed: S/Chef de la SUrete.

------

法国巡捕房报告，日期1936年8月4日（10607）
---

1936年8月4日下午，德国人 J. LOCH 先生来到办公室，确认了附呈给警察总监的信件内容。他不愿意见到他的儿子，只希望警方对后者向其父亲的部分客户借款的若干金额进行记录。

儿子 Vladimir 目前居住在瓦隆路56号。应我方要求，他来到我局，并获悉了其父亲提出的投诉。他坚称自己无缘无故被父亲“踢出”家门。他表示自己失业，钱是从朋友那里借的，而不是从他父亲的客户那里借的。我们让他明白，如果有任何正式投诉提出，他将被逮捕并送交主管法院受审。

已告知其父亲我们所做的努力，他对此表示满意。

签署：保安处副处长
